atmosphere.description: Bioluminescent coral ruins lit by drifting thermal plumes, murky abyssal water, and pulsing teal vents.

combat_loop.core_mechanic: Players redirect deep-sea thermal currents from Coral Thermal Vents to weave a hydro-barrier that shields them and amplifies damage against the Leviathan Abyssal Warden.
phases: Phase 1: Awaken the vents and learn current redirection.
Phase 2: Weave the hydro-barrier while dodging collapsing pressure waves.
Phase 3: Overcharge the barrier to shatter the Warden's coral plating.

npc_dialogue_preview: The Warden stirs in the trench below. Channel the thermal vents, shape the currents into a hydro-barrier, and the Leviathan's hide will break against the deep.
prompt_directive: Create an ancient sunken coral temple in the Abyssal Trenches where players manipulate deep-sea thermal currents into a hydro-barrier to defeat the Leviathan Abyssal Warden.
zone_title: The Sunken Coral Temple of the Abyssal Trenches
